class.name: NNDistanceToNode2DSearchCriterion
class.brief_description: Scores and filters based on minimum and maximum distance to the set [member distance_to] node.
class.description: The [Node2D] distance search criterion scores and filters [Node2D] candidates based on their global distance to [member distance_to]. If [member distance_to] is not set, nodes are left unfiltered with a score of [code]1.0[/code]. Both filtering and scoring use squared distances. When used for scoring, the raw score is mapped linearly in squared distance as [code](distance_squared - min_distance^2) / (max_distance^2 - min_distance^2)[/code], clamped to [code]0.0[/code] at or below [member min_distance] and [code]1.0[/code] at or above [member max_distance], then passed through [member NNNQSSearchCriteria.activation_curve] if one is set.

members.member: The [Node2D] whose global position candidate distances are measured to. When [code]null[/code], candidates are left unfiltered with a score of [code]1.0[/code]. If the node is freed, this property reads as [code]null[/code] and is treated as unset.

Maximum distance. Distances above this are filtered out when [member NNNQSSearchCriteria.use_for_filtering] is [code]true[/code], and map to a raw score of [code]1.0[/code] when scoring (linear in squared distance). Must be greater than [member min_distance]; smaller or equal values are ignored.

Minimum distance. Distances below this are filtered out when [member NNNQSSearchCriteria.use_for_filtering] is [code]true[/code], and map to a raw score of [code]0.0[/code] when scoring (linear in squared distance). Must be at least [code]0.0[/code] and less than [member max_distance]; invalid values are ignored.
